title: Energy Market Data Hub
problem: North American power trading desks were reconciling market signals across disconnected vendor feeds, so positions lagged the market.
approach: Built ingestion and dbt transformation layers on Snowflake and Azure, with CI/CD and data-quality gates on every load.

title: Pharma Commercial Intelligence
problem: A top-5 US pharma client needed go-to-market reporting across hundreds of KPIs, rebuilt by hand each cycle.
approach: Designed an end-to-end Dataiku and Snowflake pipeline with automated KPI computation and query-level optimisation.

title: Tableau Automation Framework
problem: Refreshing extracts and editing workbook XML by hand consumed days of analyst time every reporting cycle.
approach: Wrote a Python framework over the Tableau REST API that scripts extract refreshes and workbook XML edits.

title: Enterprise RAG Knowledge Agent
problem: Internal documentation was searchable by keyword only, so answers spanning several documents were never found.
approach: Retrieval-augmented generation over an internal corpus, with agentic workflows for multi-step reasoning.
